label: Diagram 2
caption: Diagram 2 | Requirement RA1 – schematic example of gigabit-ready physical infrastructure
description:
This schematic diagram sits above a green banner reading 'Diagram 2' and 'Requirement RA1 – schematic example of gigabit-ready physical infrastructure from the network termination point to a point as close as is reasonably practicable to the network distribution point, where there is no right to install infrastructure in land to reach the network distribution point'.

On the left, a grey house shape stands above the label 'Dwelling/building containing more than one dwelling'. Inside, a hollow green circle is labelled 'Network termination point (for each dwelling in building, see Diagrams 5 and 6)'. A green line runs down and right to a second green circle at the house edge, labelled 'Access point/ common access point'.

From it a green line runs down and right to a hollow green circle below the ground line, labelled 'Gigabit-ready physical infrastructure (ducting)'.

Further right on the ground line, a solid black bar is labelled 'Land in relation to which the developer has no right to install infrastructure'. Beyond it a square outline is labelled 'Network distribution point'; a black line drops from it and runs right, labelled 'Gigabit-capable public electronic communications network (spine network)'.
